description: This file defines the GenericDispatcherFactory class, which implements the LocalDispatcherFactory interface. It provides methods to create and manage dispatchers for services, including enabling/disabling ECAS, and running services synchronously and asynchronously within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcherFactory
classes.description: Implements LocalDispatcherFactory to create and manage service dispatchers within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericDispatcher
classes.description: Default implementation of LocalDispatcher, handling synchronous and asynchronous service execution, and ECAS control.

methods.name: createLocalDispatcher
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a LocalDispatcher instance by name, associating it with a Delegator.

methods.name: disableEcas
methods.description: Disables the ECAS feature for the dispatcher.

methods.name: enableEcas
methods.description: Enables the ECAS feature for the dispatcher.

methods.name: isEcasDisabled
methods.description: Checks if ECAS is currently disabled.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously by name with the provided context.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with transaction timeout and transaction requirement options.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously with context as varargs.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously and ignores the result.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Runs a service synchronously with transaction options and ignores the result.

methods.name: runAsync
